        total=nw.col("price") * nw.col("quantity")
    )

# Test with pandas
pdf = pd.DataFrame({
    "price": [10, 20, 30],
    "quantity": [2, 3, 4]

print(f"Output type: {type(add_total(pdf))}\n")

# Test with polars
pldf = pl.DataFrame({
    "price": [10, 20, 30],
    "quantity": [2, 3, 4]
})
print("Polars input:")
print(pldf)
print("\nPolars output:")
print(add_total(pldf))
